may_close_rule: water beside the road reaches the road crest: Phi((0 - f) / 0.15), f = lidar crest - peak water surface within 30 m; candidate, not in p_close until confirmed on a second storm
sag_rule: optional layer: road sag / underpass in a closed lidar depression whose drains (HEC-22 10-yr, 50-yr at underpasses) are exceeded by the peak-hour rain on its catchment, or where the model ponds 0.30 m; not in p_close or p_may_close
edge_rule: optional layer: fast shallow runoff beside / along the road above the permissible speed (Fortier & Scobey; ~1.0 m/s) AND shear (HEC-15 Table 2.3 gravel, 11 Pa) of a gravel / loam shoulder; in p_close only with --edge
solver: acceleration (local inertial, Bates et al. 2010) on GPU (cuda)

labels_segments.note: recall = share of documented sites with a matched segment at P >= 0.5; random_recall = the same for random flagging of the same share of segments; lift = recall / random_recall; lift_naive = recall / flagged share. strict: segments within 30 m of the site; loose: 100 m (exact) / 300 m + same-name segments within 1.5 km (approx). Line labels (.geojson): segments with >= 50 % of their points within 30 m (loose 100 m) of the closed stretch, or holding >= 50 % of it
